title: Save a reading list
context: A fictional reading app. Examples propose behavior, not a final screen design.
constraints: Use synthetic fixtures and the real application entry points.

goals.outcome: Articles stay in your reading list after restart.

visuals.commitment: Articles stay in your reading list after restart.
Removing Field notes removes only that article; River walk stays saved after restart.

checks.label: Save an article
checks.expectation: A reader saves Field notes once. It appears exactly once in the reading list after restarting the app.
checks.conditions: The reader is signed in and Field notes is not saved.
checks.method: Open Field notes, select Save, restart the app, and inspect the reading list and stored article IDs. Assert exactly one entry for Field notes.

checks.label: Repeated saves stay single
checks.expectation: Repeating Save for the same article keeps exactly one saved entry, including simultaneous requests.
checks.conditions: Use the same reader and article ID; start from an empty reading list.
checks.method: Send two concurrent Save requests with the same reader/article pair through the real API. Restart the app. Assert one stored entry and one visible row.

checks.label: Remove a saved article
checks.expectation: Removing Field notes removes only that article; River walk stays saved after restart.
checks.conditions: Both articles are saved for the same reader.
checks.method: Remove Field notes in the UI, restart, then inspect the list and storage. Assert River walk remains and Field notes is absent.
